name: Photo Jigsaw
description: Cut your own photos into tabbed jigsaw puzzles and piece them back together, with cropping, hints, saves and records
help: Pick a photo, drag the crop range, choose 3×3 / 4×4 / 6×6 and start; pieces keep a fixed orientation so the game is about finding the right spot.
The wheel zooms anchored at the pointer and dragging empty space pans; a piece dropped near its target snaps to the exact slot, wrong spots stay unfinished.
Filter edge / corner / inner pieces, toggle a faint image hint, or reveal one piece with the hint button (counted).
Placed pieces lock in place; the game is only complete when every piece sits at its exact slot. Progress auto-saves and you can switch between photos.
